purpose: Prevent arbitrary odds bands from being presented as expected-value thresholds before a reproducible pre-race probability source exists.
finding: The legacy Stage1 engine transforms already-existing per-car winner probabilities into ticket probabilities via a Plackett-Luce construction; it does not generate current-race winner probabilities from PRE fields.
allowed_now: freeze PRE source URLs and cutoff times
preserve owner-observed late odds with observation timestamp
produce ordinal candidate rankings only if their formula is prespecified and clearly labeled non-probabilistic
not_allowed_until_probability_source_rea: claim a combo has high expected value
publish a break-even odds threshold as model-derived
publish a buy range derived from an uncalibrated arbitrary score transform
silently reuse third-party prediction marks as MULTIVERSE probabilities
probability_readiness_requirements: PRE-only reproducible scoring formula or trained model
parameter fitting only on authorized chronological training data
hard_rule: No fabricated probability or odds band merely to make the workflow look complete.
